purpose: Fezolinetant is used to treat moderate to severe hot flashes caused by menopause. It helps reduce how often hot flashes happen and how intense they feel. This medication is a non-hormonal option, meaning it does not contain estrogen or other hormones.
how_it_works: During menopause, certain brain cells become overactive and trigger the body to suddenly feel very hot, causing hot flashes. Fezolinetant works by blocking a specific signal in the brain called neurokinin 3, which is responsible for setting off these hot flashes. By calming that signal, your body temperature stays more stable and hot flashes happen less often and feel less severe.
common_side_effects: The most common side effects include stomach pain, diarrhea, nausea, and trouble sleeping (insomnia). Some people may notice elevated liver enzyme levels on blood tests, which is why your doctor will check your liver before and during treatment.
warnings: This medication should not be used if you have liver problems or take certain medications that affect liver enzymes, such as fluvoxamine. Your doctor will do blood tests to check your liver before you start and periodically while you are taking it. Tell your doctor about all medications and supplements you take, as some can interact with fezolinetant. Stop taking it and call your doctor right away if you notice yellowing of your skin or eyes, dark urine, or severe stomach pain, as these could be signs of liver problems.
typical_dosing: The usual dose is 45 mg taken by mouth once a day, with or without food. Try to take it at the same time each day to keep it working consistently.
